subject.title: [UX/Bug] Model selection array order is strictly bound to checkbox ticking sequence, causing unintended primary/fallback assignment

question: Should this be transferred or recreated in the OpenClaw runtime repository rather than tracked as ClawHub work?
rationale: The report is concrete and aligned with OpenClaw priorities, but the affected runtime model picker and sync code are not present in this ClawHub checkout.

options.title: Move to runtime repo
options.body: Track the bug where `openclaw configure`, model-role persistence, and Web UI/WebSocket sync are implemented, preserving this issue as context.

options.title: Keep as ClawHub triage
options.body: Leave this open here only as a cross-repo maintainer placeholder until the owning runtime repository is confirmed.

options.title: Define a ClawHub gap
options.body: Keep implementation work in ClawHub only if maintainers identify a concrete registry, package, or CLI integration change needed for model provider configuration.

recommendation.title: Move to runtime repo
recommendation.body: Track the bug where `openclaw configure`, model-role persistence, and Web UI/WebSocket sync are implemented, preserving this issue as context.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest adjacent routing owner from current ClawHub CLI/config history and related CLI taxonomy work.
